title: Unit Event — Light Up the Fire — Episode6 Using What Time You Have

meta.Episode: Episode6 — Using What Time You Have
meta.Event Outline: Vivid BAD SQUAD's explosive third event has roused expectations that the team might actually surpass RAD WEEKEND. That's when Taiga summons them for "an important conversation"...

rows.Line: The next day
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: (So, five months...)

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: (I-I'm having trouble getting my mind to focus... Even though I have so little time left...)

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
(Five months.
What do I...?)

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: (What I do want to do in that time?)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line:
Alright, here we go!
You too, Aunt Nagi! Promise to listen!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
(Right...
I promised to teach An how to sing... I need to stay strong in front of her.)

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Then, let's hear it.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line:
Okay!
Get ready because I really practiced hitting my high notes!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
(An's improved so much...
She sounds completely different compared to a month ago.)

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: (It's hard to believe that she's already mastered what I showed her the other day...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: How'd I do?!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Yeah, you did great!
You sang those high notes really beautifully!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: I did?! Really?!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Yes, really!
Would I lie to you, An?

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line:
Yeah, that was really cool!
I love how your voice has this boom to it!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line:
But you still have some rough edges.
Just a little bit more fine control and you'll sound even better.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: Hm... Okay, got it!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: So, like this?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: (Wow, she figured it out. Her intuition's so good.)

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: (I remember how everyone around town used to watch me sing like they're doing for her now. They were always nice enough to give me advice about how to project my voice or what it takes to be a musician too...)

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line:
Wow, Nagi!
You're so young, but can already sing like this! You've definitely got a bright future ahead of you!

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: You said you're gonna rule the world someday, right? That means you need to learn as much as you can!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: (I'm here because of them...)

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: (I learned to love music here. I practiced singing, I met Ken and we chased after some crazy dreams as a team. And...)

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: (I want to go out with a bang here... In the city I love...)

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: (Yeah, I've decided.)

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: (How to use the time I have.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line:
Whew...
Okay, how was that?!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Yeah, I can't believe how much you've improved. I know you're just going to keep getting better and better in the future, An.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
Just wait, Aunt Nagi! I'll be better than you someday!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: And when that happens, we're gonna do an event together!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: (Together...?)

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: (Singing with An when her voice has fully matured sounds like a lot of fun...)

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: (But by then, I'll be...)

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: (No, wait... What if...?)
That night

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
What's gotten into you, Nagi?
Why'd you ask us to gather so late?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: How are you feeling today? Okay, I hope...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm fine. But I appreciate the concern.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Anyway, I've made my decision.
About how I want to spend my remaining time.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You already figured it out?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
I did.
Actually, it wasn't really all that hard to decide.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I want to go out with a bang by putting on an event here.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: An event...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Here? As in Vivid Street...?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: That's right.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: An event so big and spectacular that everyone's going to be talking about it for years to come! That kind of an event!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I know it won't be easy, and I'll be asking a lot from you two...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: So, Taiga, Ken...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Please...
Help me make this event happen.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
I get how you feel...
But are you really in any shape to sing...?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
I've already discussed this with the hospital.
I told them how there's one last thing I want to do in life and that I need their help.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Their initial response was that it'd be too much, but they eventually agreed after I begged and begged...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: An said something today when I was teaching her earlier...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: How she'll be better than me someday, and that we're going to sing on stage together when that happens.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: That was when I realized that I'll never get to do that with her...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: B-But...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Even after I'm gone, An... No, not just An. Someone on Vivid Street will continue to sing.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Just like back in the day when I... You two... We all sang like there was no tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: That's why we're here.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I want this event to give the kids who come and see it the same inspiration we felt all those years ago. I want them to dream of becoming the best musicians ever.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: That way, I—our dream—can go on with them.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Nagi...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: (In other words, the next generation...)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: As a parent, I sort of understand what you're getting at.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Watching youngsters grow up and reach heights that we couldn't... It's an inspiring thought.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Oh, for the love of...!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Taiga...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Alright, fine! If you wanna do one last event here, be my guest! I'll respect your final wishes.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
But that last part...
Letting the next generation take our dream further? No! Nuh-uh!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I'm not about to let some complete stranger take our dream away from us...!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Taiga, that's not what Nagi's saying.
She just wants the next generation to—

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: That depends on who's asking and who's listening. Nagi, don't tell me you're actually okay with entrusting someone you've never met before with our dream?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: It's our dream! You should entrust it to us!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Ken and I can still sing, so we'll sing for you!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: We're gonna become the best musicians in the world...!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: And when we sing at the biggest venue in the world, you'll hear us! We'll be so loud you'll need earplugs in the afterlife!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Then, you'll know that we're the best!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: That our dream came true!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Because that's... That's the only thing I can do...!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Taiga...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Thanks, Taiga...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I don't want you to do that for me.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I want you two to walk your own paths and follow your own dreams.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I mean, Taiga, you've always been an absolute ape. And Ken, you act all cool and calm, but you do some really crazy stuff from time to time. You two really are a handful...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: But I still love watching you do what you're so passionate about.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Anyway, I want this event to happen!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: As a musician, I want to end things by having the best time in the best place in the world with my best friends.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: You'll help me with that, right, Taiga?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Then it's settled. I'll find us a venue, while you two wrangle up anyone who's willing to join us!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Nagi...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: When...do you plan on telling An all this?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Oh... Hm...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Sorry, I'd rather not just yet...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Because you think she won't be able to handle it?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Well, there's that...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: And one other reason.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: What reason?
A few days later
COL

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line:
Wow, um...
That's a hard pill to swallow...

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: If your time's come, then maybe I should pack up shop as well...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Wait, why?! Just because I'll be gone soon doesn't mean you have to close this place!

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: Hey, I can't run this place forever! Have you forgotten how old I am? Yes, I look young for my age, but I'll be eighty soon. Some peace and quiet sure does sound nice.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Right. I'm sorry...
But the thought of COL closing down is such a sad thought...

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: Nagi, are you sure you're okay?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Me? Uhh... Haha.
Yeah, I'm fine.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: All I've been thinking about is our event! I even have a name for it already, but that'll remain a secret for now.

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: I see... Just don't push yourself too hard, okay? I'm talking both physically and mentally.

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: I'm old, so I've also given the end some thought. I understand what you're going through, but I doubt Taiga or Ken really do.

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: When I was young, I hated the thought of growing old, but I've gained a lot of wisdom over the years. Because of that, I know what you're feeling right now.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Granny...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
You're still as sharp as ever.
And I really appreciate it.
A few days later
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: (Nagi's been at the hospital since this morning. I hope things haven't taken a turn for the worse...)

rows.Speaker: RUST Member
rows.Line: Hey, Ken. This studio's nice.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Oh, thanks for coming.
I'm looking forward to practicing with you all today.

rows.Speaker: RUST Member
rows.Line: So, how's Taiga doing...?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: He still needs time to sort things out...

rows.Speaker: RUST Member
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's understandable...
Anyway, who else is gonna be performing in this event?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Oh, about that.
They should be arriving shortly...

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member
rows.Line: Oh, you guys are already here! Sorry for the wait!

rows.Speaker: RUST Member
rows.Line:
What? No way! GLaP day?!
How did you get ahold of them?!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: We've been rivals ever since our days with the big label, so I had a feeling they'd be willing to lend us a hand.

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member
rows.Line: Thanks for inviting us, Ken, Taiga.

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member
rows.Line: We weren't sure about this at first, but it became an easy choice after we heard that it's gonna be Nagi's swan song. We probably would've regretted it for the rest of our lives if we refused.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
I can't thank you all enough.
I really appreciate you joining us for this.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Sorry I'm late!
My appointment took a lot longer than I was expecting!

rows.Speaker: RUST Member
rows.Line:
Hey, Nagi!
So, how do you feel? Are you up for this?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Of course! I'm as fit as a... Okay, not really... But I've made my decision, so I promise to be ready by the day of!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Preparing for this event has even been helping me get through my treatment.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
So, let's start practicing!
I'm itching to sing because the hospital was so boring.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Alright...
Then, let's begin!

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member
rows.Line:
Wow, she's still got it.
Even in her current state, her singing's really inspiring.

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member
rows.Line:
I mean, is she even sick...?
I feel like she's singing with more power than usual.

rows.Speaker: RUST Member
rows.Line: Yeah, I don't think she's ever sung like this before...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: She's putting absolutely everything she has left into this event...

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member
rows.Line: And we gotta do the same...
Two hours later

rows.Speaker: RUST Member
rows.Line: Okay, see you all tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member
rows.Line: Get home safe!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Thanks for coming.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Where's Nagi?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: She said she was going back to grab her jacket.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Nagi did really well today.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I really hope we get to see her sing on stage.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Me too...
Huff... Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Wait, that sounds like...!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Nagi!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Hey, what happened?!

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
Sorry, I'm fine. I know this doesn't look good, but...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Stop it! Now's not the time to be acting all tough! You know that!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
You're drenched in sweat...!
Sit tight! I'll go find you some water!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: How do you feel? Better?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
*Nod*
It looks like my painkillers wore off, but I'm okay now...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Okay...
That's a relief...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I really had fun during practice today.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: We sang, argued about how we want to do things and sang some more...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I wish we could've kept doing that forever.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: But I know that's not realistic since this sort of thing keeps happening...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
I can feel it...
With each passing day, my body breaks down more.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I'm feeling nauseous more often, and the painkillers aren't working as well as they did before...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Even so, I'm going to try to hang on until the event...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: But... After that, well...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Nagi...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I just wanted to grow old and keep singing here.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
You and I would've forever been single!
But we'd always have the Shiraishis, and I was going to watch An blossom into a beautiful lady...like me...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: On Vivid Street... Together...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Forever...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I don't want to die...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I want to be here...forever...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I... I want to keep singing...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I want to keep living life with you and everyone else...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Sorry...
I must've sounded so pathetic just now.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You idiot...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: What did I just say about acting tough...?! Have you forgotten we're family...?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I know... I'm sorry, Taiga...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Actually, Taiga, Ken...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Yeah...?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Can I ask a weird favor of you guys?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: A weird favor...?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: After I'm gone...
